guarantees.claim: The constant array Depth is assigned the values: {1344/MsgWidth, 1152/MsgWidth, 1088/MsgWidth, 832/MsgWidth, 576/MsgWidth}.

assumptions.claim: MsgWidth must be an integer divisor of 1344, 1152, 1088, 832, and 576 to produce correct Depth values.
assumptions.cond: when Depth is used to compute block size
assumptions.risk: Incorrect division leads to wrong block depth, corrupting hash state.

assumptions.claim: The ordering of these five expressions must match the encoding of the SHA-3 mode selection signal used elsewhere.
assumptions.cond: when a mode selects the depth
assumptions.risk: Mismatched ordering causes wrong depth for a mode, potentially skipping message bytes or causing underflow/overflow.

uncertain_points.claim: If MsgWidth is configurable and set to a value not dividing the rate values, integer division truncates and yields incorrect Depth.
uncertain_points.cond: MsgWidth not a divisor of the rates
uncertain_points.risk: Hash engine may process wrong number of message words per block, producing an incorrect digest.

uncertain_points.claim: Depth order must match SHA-3 mode enumeration indices; a mismatch would assign wrong depth to a mode.
uncertain_points.cond: when mode selection index is used to index Depth
uncertain_points.risk: Incorrect depth leads to wrong hash operation length.
